Yes and no.

I feel like a link, post, or comment should have a visible point system. This is an integral part of the process to me, and part of the reason I left Reddit (when they took away the vote breakdown). It helps us determine quality content from bad content from controversial content. For instance:

A post with two contribution points can mean a ton of things, but being told it only has two points tells us nothing. Does it only have two upvotes? Because this means that it's either getting little to no attention, or it isn't quality content. Does it have 1176 upvotes and 1174 downvotes? Because this tells us that it's a highly visible, highly controversial topic that's very engaging to the audience. And all of this numerical information is nice for the users.

But I don't need to know that OP literally has a total of 48 SCP and 0 CCP at this very moment... this information is irrelevant to me, and it only provides a measuring device for a pissing contest. Maybe it'll good for a user to see their OWN contribution totals, but there's no need for anyone else to see that.

Allowing someone to see their own total can give them incentive to contribute quality material, which would be beneficial to the community. It'll give them a sense of accomplishment for doing good work, and help them determine if their content is good or not... which can help steer their content into the correct direction... helping the community. And I don't mean contributing to the circlejerk (which could possibly happen), I mean submitting quality content instead of crap content.

But allowing the community to see (and compare) each other's totals opens the doors to competition, which leads to poor content for the sake of collecting more points than the other guy. This sounds like what we're trying to avoid, since it'll lead to reposts, bad content, and circlejerks.

TL;DR: I think a user's total contribution point breakdown should be hidden to everyone but that specific user. I feel like a post/comment should have visible points for all to see.
